visual quality assessment before project completion Download ExcelDownload PDF **11** Checkpoints **5** Sections Per painted area; final inspection before handover QC Engineer, Painting Contractor [IS 2395:2007](https://infralens.in/code/IS-2395-Part-1-2000) Related [📐IS 2395](https://infralens.in/code/IS-2395) [✏️Concrete cover](https://infralens.in/thumbrules/concrete-cover-by-exposure) [📘Paint & Coating Coverage Ra…](https://infralens.in/handbook/paint-coverage) [📖Min cover for RCC](https://infralens.in/knowledge/minimum-cover-rcc-is-456) [🔧rcc-design](https://infralens.in/tools/rcc-design) ### Checklist Preview Expand all ↓ | S.No. | Checkpoint | IS Requirement | Status | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | A. COLOR UNIFORMITY ASSESSMENT | | A1 | Color uniformity: Uniform color across entire surface; no color variation, streaking, or patchy areas
Acceptance: Color variation <5 degrees (visual); no lighter/darker bands; smooth color transition at joints | Cl. 401 — Color compliance | | | B. SURFACE FINISH QUALITY | | B1 | Surface smoothness: Finish smooth; brush marks minimal (<1mm visible); roller patterns blended
Acceptance: Smooth feel to touch; minimal texture; acceptable for interior matte/satin finishes | Cl. 401 — Finish quality | | | B2 | Gloss level: Gloss appropriate for paint type (matte, satin, gloss); uniform across surface
Acceptance: Matte/satin acceptable; gloss uniform; no glossy spots indicating over-application | Cl. 401 — Gloss assessment | | | C. DEFECT ASSESSMENT | | C1 | Drips & Sags: No drips >2mm; no sags or heavy accumulation; edges clean and straight
Acceptance: Drips <2mm acceptable (polish out); sags indicate over-application; edges straight | Cl. 401 — Application control | | | C2 | Brush Marks: No prominent brush marks; texture even; consistent application technique
Acceptance: <1mm visible marks; marks acceptable for matte finishes; <0.5mm for glossy finishes | Cl. 401 — Application technique | | | C3 | Bare Spots / Coverage: 100% coverage; no substrate showing through; primer coverage complete
Acceptance: No bare spots visible; color uniform; primer edge not visible at joints | Cl. 401 — Coverage verification | | | C4 | Dust/Foreign Matter: No dust particles embedded; surface clean; no contamination visible
